facts.fact: FOLUCCO's director general said on 18 June 2026 it will launch a pilot digitising the Gombe Tribunal de paix and its prosecutor's office, with funding already available, under the Justice 2.0 programme whose projects include an integrated judicial case management system.
facts.system: Justice 2.0 integrated judicial case management system
